# M'Caravane Kelibia

> M'Caravane is a local activity operator in Kélibia, on Tunisia's Cap Bon
> peninsula, running guided quad excursions, camel and horse rides on the beach,
> and tours of the Kelibia Fort and museum. Guides speak French, English and
> Italian, and every booking is made over WhatsApp.

## Activities

- [Quad excursion]({{SITE_URL}}/en#experiences): dunes, coastal trails and pine forest with the Fort on the horizon; no experience needed, briefing and helmet included. Suits first-timers and groups wanting the adrenaline option. Runs 1h or 2h.
- [Camel ride]({{SITE_URL}}/en#experiences): a caravan along El Mansoura beach at sunrise or sunset, on calm animals suited to families. Mint tea and photos included. Runs 30 min or 1h.
- [Horse ride]({{SITE_URL}}/en#experiences): the same shoreline route on horseback, with longer options for confident riders. Booked alongside the camel ride.
- [City and museum tour]({{SITE_URL}}/en#experiences): the Byzantine Fort, the old harbour and the museum's Punic and Roman collection with a guide; Kerkouane optional. Runs 3h or a half day.

## Practical information

- Location: Hotel Kelibia Beach, Kélibia, Tunisia
- Languages: French, English, Italian
- Booking: WhatsApp +216 25 434 499
- Email: hello@mcaravane.tn
- All experiences are guided, insured and beginner-friendly, and run in small groups.

## Notes

The site is a single page per language. Activities, gallery and contact details
are sections of that page, addressed by the anchors above; there are no separate
activity pages. Prices are not published on the site - they are quoted over
WhatsApp.
